verdict.rationale: GoDaddy documents an official MCP server (developer.godaddy.com/en/docs/api-users/mcp) that lets AI assistants search domains and check availability directly from conversation, confirmed by both docs and an independent probe hitting the live page. Missing for 10: no independent/community corroboration of real-world usage, and the documented MCP server scope is limited (search/availability only) rather than covering full domain management.
